I Survived 100 Days in an OCEAN in Minecraft Hardcore 1.21.3
Minecraft Hardcore Mode is the hardest difficulty of the game Minecraft. If you die in Minecraft Hardcore Mode, you`ll die forever and the world will be deleted. Hardcore Mode has a slightly higher difficulty than just Hardcore. Mobs spawn even more actively, attack even harder and have even more stamina and detection range than when playing on Hard Survival difficulty.
